What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-5 \\ 5{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Systems of Equations as Augmented Matrices

feedback.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2}+4{x}_{1}=3{x}_{3} \\ -11{x}_{3}=12\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=0 \\ 0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3}=12\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -11\end{aligned}]
$$
